references.rejection_note: Every construction strategy tried was rejected on direct human visual comparison against the reference (2026-08-13): none of them produced a model that read as a recognizable pipe wrench, regardless of silhouette IoU. Root cause: a pipe wrench's fixed jaw is a genuine hook/overhang, structurally separate from the movable jaw and adjustment wheel -- no per-height cross-section sweep (an ellipse, or an asymmetric quadrant-blend) can represent that, however parameterized, because the object is not star-shaped from any central axis at any height. A traced-outline extrusion with real separate parts (Jaw_Housing, Movable_Jaw, Adjustment_Wheel) came closer -- adding a Subdivision Surface modifier fixed a related faceted-cage defect the same way it did on the watering can's Rose_Head -- but was still rejected as not good enough on direct review. All wrench run directories, tools, the models/ file, and readiness entries were removed rather than kept as a partial or false pass, per explicit user instruction, matching the boombox's own precedent.
